summary: Support for RoyalRoad's new beta layout, with nothing to set up.
new: Recaps and blurbs now work on RoyalRoad's new beta layout as well as the classic one
RoyalRefresh detects which layout RoyalRoad served you and adapts on its own, so switching layouts with RoyalRoad's own control just works
Custom CSS selectors are now saved separately for each layout, so a tweak for one can't break the other
fixes: The page no longer jumps to the recap while it is still loading, which used to shift the text under you
The report link now sits next to RoyalRoad's own report button on the new layout, and is readable on both light and dark themes
The 'Reduced Motion detected' note now appears with the scroll setting it actually affects
